input.value: own maple tree fell in wind, damaged hood and windshield of parked car

input.rationale: Tree fell on policyholder's own parked vehicle causing hood and windshield damage, which is comprehensively covered auto damage.

Damage to hood and windshield of a vehicle typically runs $2,000–$8,000 in repair costs; falls in the medium range and will likely require adjuster inspection to assess structural and mechanical integrity.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim's parked vehicle (POL-1005) was struck by falling maple tree from their own yard during last night's windstorm, damaging the hood and windshield. Medium-severity comprehensive auto claim with $1,000 deductible; vehicle inspection needed to assess full scope of damage.
